name: Jet Fighter
operating_principle: The aircraft uses a combination of advanced propulsion systems, including variable intake nozzles and thrust vectoring, to achieve supersonic speeds and high maneuverability. The empennage and fuselage are designed to reduce drag and provide stability during flight.

components.description: The main structural body of the aircraft, providing a streamlined shape for reduced drag.
The tail section of the aircraft, consisting of the horizontal and vertical stabilizers, which provide stability and control during flight.
The lifting surface of the aircraft, providing the necessary lift for flight.
The system of wheels, struts, and other components that support the aircraft during takeoff, landing, and taxiing.
The system of engines, fuel tanks, and other components that provide the power for the aircraft.
The electronic systems that provide navigation, communication, and other functions for the aircraft.
The weapons and other systems used for combat and defense.
The ailerons, elevators, and rudder that provide control during flight.
